
EXPORT-WORK-UNITS
Export work units to JSON or CSV format

USAGE
  fspec export-work-units <format> <output> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <format> (required)
    Output format: json or csv
  <output> (required)
    Output file path

OPTIONS
  --status <status>
    Filter by status
  --epic <epic>
    Filter by epic

EXAMPLES
  1. Export to JSON
  $ fspec export-work-units json work-units.json
  ✓ Exported 42 work units to work-units.json

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec list-work-units
  fspec query-work-units
